mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 1% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% YoY but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) are both rising, it signals a stagflationary environment that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline by more than 2% month-over-month, it signals a sharp drop in consumer demand that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 2% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
